name: Utsumi Hayato
source:
Younger brother of Utsumi Hinowa and the protagonist's kouhai.
He is a cheerful boy who belongs to the baseball club.
However, he is often pushed around by his older sister, who has a strong sense of humor.

If he makes a crack at his sister, he is told, "You're rather cocky, aren't you, Hayato.....?"

[translated from [url=http://wonder-fool.jp/ningyohime/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
